title: 第21章 决斗邀约第22章 教训
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
纪云彤还是个小姑娘，说不过汪直，脸涨的通红也憋不出一句话来。
汪直面露得意之色，挤开纪云彤对办事弟子道：“给侯三登记。”
若在这件事上相让，汪管事一派以后肯定会更加得寸进尺，对方管事竞争长老之位也很不利。
纪云彤咬了咬牙，刚想跟汪直拼了，一条手臂就挡到了她面前。
楚少野走上前道：“且慢，这位汪师兄，我虽然年纪轻，但是做事也是一把好手，你怎么能断定我不能胜任药园的工作呢？”
汪直好整以暇地看着他，“胆子倒是不小，那你又如何证明你有能力呢？”
楚少野道：“既然大家都是灵主，当然要以灵主的方法证明，我愿意跟这位侯师兄决斗，七日后，胜利的人便获得这份药园的工作。”
汪直眯眼看他，这小子年纪轻轻，还是个杂役弟子，天赋必然不怎么样，竟然敢跟侯三决斗。
别人找死他自然不会拦着，甚至乐见其成。
汪直冷笑了一声，“看在你小子还算有些胆气的份上，我就答应你。”
“不过本公子的时间宝贵，不能浪费在你们这些杂役身上，七日太长，只有三日。”
楚少野拱手道：“那就三日。”
汪直甩了甩袖子，带着侯三走出人事堂，“三日后巳时，叠翠峰训练场。”
“纪云彤，你可得好好看着这个小子，别到时候不敢来了。”
汪直哈哈大笑着离去，纪云彤对着他的背影呸了一口，“嘴张那么大，生怕接不到鸟屎还是怎么的。”
楚少野被她的话逗笑了，被纪云彤瞪了一眼。
“你还笑的出来，侯三虽然实力不怎么样，但是你才刚进宗门，什么都没学会，拿什么跟他决斗？”
人事堂不是说话的地方，纪云彤带楚少野到了一处偏僻的竹林。
“把你的本命灵兽召唤出来给我看看。”
楚少野很听话的将小狐狸召唤了出来。

小狐狸一出来就贴着楚少野的小腿嘤嘤嘤的撒娇，雪白蓬松的大尾巴摇来摇去。
纪彤云眼睛一亮，没想到楚少野的本命灵宠这么可爱，一时间气都消了不少，她对楚少野道：“我能摸摸它吗？”
楚少野点点头，“只要雪无同意就行。”
“名字叫雪无啊，有点奇怪，但是还挺好听的。”
她将一只手伸到小狐狸面前，小狐狸歪头看了看她，见是漂亮的小姑娘，很给面子的将爪子递了过去。
纪云彤捏住软软的肉垫，幸福感一瞬间爆棚，“好可爱啊，是雪狐还是月光狐啊？”
还没等楚少野回答，她便自问自答道：“雪狐的眼睛应该是蓝色的，不是雪狐，月光狐额头上应该有月牙印记，也不是月光狐，还有什么白色的狐狸呢？”
“是无垢狐。”
纪云彤讶然，原来这就是传说中的无垢狐啊，多亏了弘毅长老，因为他，几乎全宗上下都知道这种珍贵的灵兽。
content_en:
Ji Yuntong was still a little girl, she couldn't speak to Wang Zhi, her face turned red and she couldn't hold back a word.
Wang Zhi looked proud, pushed aside Ji Yuntong and said to the disciple: "Register Hou San."
If we give in on this matter, Steward Wang and his faction will definitely push themselves further in the future, and it will also be disadvantageous for the other Steward to compete for the position of elder.
Ji Yuntong gritted her teeth. Just when she was about to fight Wang Zhi, an arm blocked her.
Chu Shaoye stepped forward and said: "Wait a minute, this Senior Brother Wang, although I am young, I am also good at work. How can you conclude that I am not qualified for the work in the medicine garden?"
Wang Zhi looked at him calmly, "You are quite courageous, so how can you prove that you are capable?"
Chu Shaoye said: "Since we are all spirit masters, of course we must prove it in the spirit master's way. I am willing to duel with this senior brother Hou. After seven days, the winner will get the job in the medicine garden."
Wang Zhi narrowed his eyes at him. This boy was young and was still a handyman disciple. His talent must not be very good. He dared to duel with Hou San.
Naturally, he would not stop others from seeking death, and would even be happy to see them succeed.
Wang Zhi sneered, "For the sake of your courage, I will agree to it."
"But my master's time is precious and cannot be wasted on you handymen. Seven days is too long. There are only three days."
Chu Shaoye cupped his hands and said, "Then three days."
Wang Zhi shook off his sleeves and led Hou San out of the personnel hall, "Three days from now, Diecuifeng training ground."
"Ji Yuntong, you have to watch this kid carefully and don't dare to come when the time comes."
Wang Zhi laughed and left. Ji Yuntong spit at his back, "Open your mouth so wide, for fear that you won't catch the bird poop or something."
Chu Shaoye was amused by her words and was glared at by Ji Yuntong.
"You can still laugh. Although Hou San is not very strong, you have just entered the sect and have learned nothing. How can you fight with him?"
The Personnel Hall was not a place to talk, so Ji Yuntong took Chu Shaoye to a remote bamboo forest.
"Summon your natal spiritual beast and show it to me."
Chu Shaoye summoned the little fox obediently.
As soon as the little fox came out, it clung to Chu Shaoye's calf and coquettishly, its big snow-white fluffy tail wagging back and forth.
Ji Tongyun's eyes lit up. She didn't expect Chu Shaoye's natal spiritual pet to be so cute. She lost a lot of her anger for a while. She said to Chu Shaoye, "Can I touch it?"
Chu Shaoye nodded, "As long as Xue Wu agrees."
"My name is Xue Wu. It's a bit strange, but it sounds pretty good."
She stretched out a hand in front of the little fox. The little fox tilted his head and looked at her. Seeing that it was a beautiful little girl, he handed her paw to her in a dignified manner.
Ji Yuntong pinched the soft flesh pad, feeling happy for a moment, "It's so cute. Is it a snow fox or a moonlight fox?"
Before Chu Shaoye could answer, she asked and answered herself: "The eyes of a snow fox should be blue, not a snow fox. There should be a crescent mark on the forehead of a moonlight fox, and it's not a moonlight fox. What kind of white fox is there?"
"It's Wugou Fox."
Ji Yuntong was surprised. It turned out that this was the legendary Wugou Fox. Thanks to Elder Hongyi, almost everyone in the sect knew about this precious spiritual beast.
